subtitle: 몹 한 무리마다 마나탐 앉는 보기 탱커

cuts.speaker: 언데드 성기사
cuts.dialogue:
쫄 한 무리에 마나 다 뺐네
잠깐 물 좀 마시고 갈게…
cuts.visual_prompt: Low-angle dungeon floor shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal dungeon stone floor touch and zero text or speech bubbles. On the left, exhausted Undead Paladin protection tank (1H mace and sturdy gold shield resting beside her on the stone) sits cross-legged sipping from an uncorked translucent blue mana glass flask with the wooden cork visibly removed on the floor next to her. On the right, bewildered Tauren Druid healer (single leafy wooden staff stowed on back) stares down blinking in confusion with drooping ears.

cuts.speaker: 드워프 사냥꾼
cuts.dialogue:
탱커가 한 무리마다 탐하냐?!
지혜의 문장 좀 켜고 쳐라!
cuts.visual_prompt: Side-profile comedic argument shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal stone floor touch and wide open pure #FFFFFF upper-right space (zero text or speech bubbles). On the left, furious Dwarf Hunter (single blunderbuss rifle stowed on back) leans forward yelling and gesturing impatiently with an empty hand while her cute 2.5-head chibi SD round chubby brown baby bear wearing a green scarf waves his paws urgently beside her. On the lower-right, unbothered Undead Paladin protection tank (1H mace and sturdy gold shield resting beside her) sits calmly lowering her uncorked blue mana glass flask with the wooden cork visibly removed on the stone beside her.

equip_effects: 근접 공격 시 일정 확률로 시전자의 마나를 회복시킵니다.

cuts.speaker: 언데드 성기사
cuts.dialogue:
어글 잡으려면 신성화 풀딜이지!
…어 또 마나 오링났네
cuts.visual_prompt: High-angle action shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal dungeon stone floor touch and zero text or speech bubbles. On the left, Undead Paladin protection tank wielding her 1H mace and sturdy gold shield stomps down unleashing a bright golden Consecration rune ring under a single tiny defeated cute 2.5-head chibi SD dungeon skeleton mob, then freezes with a giant sweat drop as her mana glow flickers out. On the right, exasperated Dwarf Hunter (single blunderbuss rifle stowed on back) and her cute 2.5-head chibi SD round chubby brown baby bear wearing a green scarf both slap their foreheads in disbelief.

Centered Dutch-tilt extreme big bust-up close-up filling 82 percent of frame height in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with zero text or speech bubbles. Undead Paladin protection tank (1H mace and sturdy gold shield leaning just behind her shoulder) sits serenely tipping up yet another uncorked translucent blue mana glass flask to her lips with deadpan heavy-lidded golden eyes, holding the removed wooden cork casually in her other hand beside a neat row of empty uncorked glass flasks.

cuts.speaker: 타우렌 드루이드
cuts.dialogue:
힐러인 나보다 탱커가
물을 더 많이 마시네…
cuts.visual_prompt: Over-the-shoulder shot from behind sitting Undead Paladin protection tank (skull cap, gold shield and 1H mace resting beside empty uncorked blue flasks in lower-right foreground) looking at Tauren Druid healer on the left, in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background (zero text or speech bubbles). On the left, exhausted Tauren Druid healer (single leafy wooden staff stowed on back) holds up her own untouched full corked blue mana glass flask comparing it weakly with teary bewildered eyes and drooping cow-hood ears.

cuts.speaker: 드워프 사냥꾼
cuts.dialogue:
달팽이보다 느린 인던이네…
막넴 전에 날 새겠다!
cuts.visual_prompt: Back-view wide slapstick comic finale in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal dungeon stone floor touch and zero text or speech bubbles. On the left, drained Dwarf Hunter (single blunderbuss rifle stowed on back) slumps forward groaning with hollow tired eyes while her cute 2.5-head chibi SD round chubby brown baby bear wearing a green scarf sprawls flat yawning wide beside her.
